verdict.rationale: Webhooks are a fair axis for a customer data platform, but the evidence pack never documents registrable outbound HTTP callbacks. The closest items are generic delivery to '200+ third-party tools', alerts that 'get notified', and a Slack agent. None of these is a documented webhook subscription a programmatic consumer can register and receive, and Slack-style notifications do not qualify.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
